verses.text: This message came to Jeremiah from the LORD during the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah:
"Go to the Rechabite family and speak to them. Bring them into one of the rooms of the LORD's temple and give them wine to drink."
So I went and got Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, along with his brothers and all his sons, the whole Rechabite family.

I brought them into the LORD's temple, into the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, the man of God. It was next to the officials' room, above the room of Maaseiah son of Shallum, the doorkeeper.
I set bowls full of wine and some cups in front of the Rechabites and said to them, "Drink some wine."
But they answered, "We do not drink wine, because our ancestor Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us: 'You and your descendants must never drink wine.
Do not build houses, plant seeds, or plant vineyards. Do not own any of these things. Instead, always live in tents. Then you will live a long time in the land where you are wanderers.'
We have obeyed everything our ancestor Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us. We have never drunk wine, nor have our wives, sons, or daughters.
We have not built houses to live in. We have no vineyards, fields, or crops.
We have lived in tents and fully obeyed everything our ancestor Jonadab commanded us.
But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded the land, we said, 'Come, let us go to Jerusalem to escape the Babylonian and Aramean armies.' That is why we are living in Jerusalem."
Then the LORD's message came to Jeremiah:
"This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, 'Will you not learn a lesson and obey my words?' says the LORD.

'Jonadab son of Rechab ordered his descendants not to drink wine, and they have obeyed him. To this day they do not drink wine, because they obey their ancestor's command. But I have spoken to you again and again, and you have not obeyed me.

Again and again I sent you all my servants the prophets. They said, "Each of you must turn from your evil ways and change what you do. Do not follow other gods to serve them. Then you will live in the land I gave to you and your ancestors." But you did not pay attention or listen to me.
The descendants of Jonadab son of Rechab have kept the command their ancestor gave them, but these people have not obeyed me.'

So this is what the LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, says: 'Look, I am going to bring on Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem all the disaster I announced against them. I spoke to them, but they did not listen. I called to them, but they did not answer.'"

Then Jeremiah said to the Rechabite family, "This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: 'You have obeyed the command of your ancestor Jonadab. You have kept all his instructions and done everything he commanded you.'
So this is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: 'Jonadab son of Rechab will never fail to have a descendant who serves me.'"
